newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - J.C. Penney estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - J.C. Penney estimates cut.

text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw Inc Tuesday reduced its first-quarter earnings estimate for J.C. Penney Co Inc to $0.54 from $0.58 to reflect the impact of slower-than-expected sales in March.

-- Rodman also lowered its estimate in the second quarter to $0.40 from $0.41 and raised its fourth-quarter estimate to $1.50 from $1.47. Rodman said the refinements better illustrate the anticipated impact of drug store acquisitions.

-- The sales shortfall in March also prompted Rodman to reduce its estimate for all of fiscal 1998, ending next January, to $3.50 from $3.52. Rodman also set an estimate for fiscal 1999 of $4.10 a share.
-- J.C. Penney closed unchanged Tuesday at 49-1/8.
